nodes.statement: A fixed positive spectral exclusion survives strong-resolvent convergence of nonnegative self-adjoint operators on an identified Hilbert space.
Specify the cutoff/volume-dependent conversion from regulator units to one common physical energy normalization and prove that the regulated lower bound is uniform after this conversion.

Construct the comparison maps or common-Hilbert realization needed to state convergence of the regulated Hamiltonians to the target continuum Hamiltonian without silently identifying inequivalent regulator state spaces.

Prove strong-resolvent convergence of the physically rescaled regulated Hamiltonians to the same limiting four-dimensional Hamiltonian, or establish a stronger generalized convergence framework with its own spectral-stability theorem.
Control the zero-energy sector separately if the limiting construction requires persistence or uniqueness of a vacuum vector; strong-resolvent gap stability alone does not supply this.

Combine one common physical-unit regulated lower bound, a justified state-space comparison, continuum convergence, the R001 stability theorem, and any required zero-sector control to discharge YM-D001.

cross_debt_dependencies.effect: The limiting Hamiltonian must belong to an actually constructed nontrivial four-dimensional continuum theory; D001-R001 cannot construct that limit.
If the Hamiltonian is obtained through Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction, the required limiting hierarchy and reconstruction hypotheses remain D002 obligations.

false_proof_firewalls: Weak resolvent convergence is not enough to preserve a spectral exclusion.
Strong-resolvent convergence does not by itself preserve a moving vacuum state.
A positive gap at every regulator is insufficient without one common positive physical-unit lower bound.
A uniform bound in raw regulator units cannot be promoted without the physical scaling map.
current_frontier: After R001 admission, the next material D001 tranche is not another abstract topology lemma. It is to bind the actual regulated Yang-Mills physical scaling and state-space comparison, and then prove the uniform lower bound plus strong-resolvent convergence or record the first exact obstruction.
certification_boundary: No node in this DAG is a MATHCERT certificate. YM-D001-R001 is a Solve candidate until protected admission; YM-D001 and YM-001 remain open.
